origin: Mechanism v1 and adaptive v2 used seed 271001 on all eight fresh graphs. V3 repeats the unchanged v2 analysis on the two as-yet-unexamined internal-state starts 271002 and 271003 for every graph and both auxiliary arms.
checkpoints: Eight graphs times two held-aside starts times two auxiliary arms = 32 frozen checkpoints. No outcome-based exclusion.
method: Exactly the role-order, unordered-identity, five random nine-dimensional subspaces, observed-only ridge fit, and 25 unseen pairs times 128 balanced episodes of mechanism v2. No choice of subspace rank, probe regularization, rendering, or metric is changed.
primary_descriptive_contrast: For each graph, average over the two starts the ordered-arm reduction in correct-minus-reversed margin after role-order subspace swap, minus the corresponding reduction in the unordered-arm. Report all eight graph values.
secondary: role-order versus unordered-identity and random subspace swaps in the ordered arm
interpretation_rule: A positive primary contrast on at least seven of eight graphs and an average above 1 margin unit is a useful replication of the v2 mechanism diagnostic. This is not an independent graph confirmation and does not prove a unique circuit.
scope: Only the synthetic coded-message/generated-scene architecture; natural-language and pretrained-LLM mechanisms remain untested.
